# for the current FLIT-FLID-CPLX_RXN entry.
# FLIT-DIMER_RXN (flagella-cascade investigation, 2026-08-05): FliT (EG11389-MONOMER)
# exists as a homodimer in solution (Yamamoto & Kutsukake 2006, J Bacteriol 188:5124:
# "FliT exists as a homodimer and binds to FliD at a 2:1 stoichiometry"). Adding the
# dimer as its own complex means the downstream FLIT-FLID-CPLX_RXN equilibrium
# (equilibrium_reactions.tsv) binds 1 FliT-dimer + 1 FliD, both order-1 reactants --
# avoiding equilibrium.py's stoichiometry>1 reactant handling (which squares the
# reverse rate constant per extra unit of stoichiometry and made a direct
# "2 FliT + 1 FliD" equilibrium reaction numerically unstable, not just biologically
# less faithful to the real homodimer-binds-FliD mechanism).
FLIT-DIMER_RXN

CPLX0-7450_RXN
